title: deskhand LAN-gate allowance file
description: Contents of the allowance file that the LAN gate (birbhomes-r-ttg5) publishes and deskhand reads (docs/contract.md section 14, 0.11-draft). The $id is an identifier, not a location. This schema checks the shape and that each timestamp is a possible one. deskhand also checks that mac names this Mac, that expires_at is later than not_before, the clock, and the file's owner, mode and directory. Self-contained on purpose, so the publisher can validate against it without the other deskhand schemas.
$comment: The patterns follow the rule of defs.json: an anchored pattern plus a not-pattern over the forbidden characters, so that a trailing newline is rejected in every regex engine. $defs.timestamp is a copy of defs.json#/$defs/timestamp and must stay identical to it.

version.description: Format version. Any change to this format gets a new value.

mac.description: The configured name of the Mac this allowance is for, as in status.mac and in the Service name deskhand-<mac>: 1 to 63 characters from a-z 0-9 -. deskhand compares it exactly with its own configured name.

not_before.description: The allowance is not valid before this time, less the configured skew tolerance.

expires_at.description: The allowance is not valid at or after this time. Must be later than not_before. Never extended by the skew tolerance.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with a literal Z offset and at most 9 fraction digits. It must be a real UTC instant. The pattern rejects an impossible month, day, hour, minute or second, including a leap second (:60). 29 February of a year that is not a leap year passes the pattern, so a validator must also assert the date-time format; deskhand rejects it either way.
